content: Dr. Mike Reed, DC, DACBSP, CCSP, CSCS, is a Doctor of Chiropractic who has been actively serving the United States Olympic Committee for several years. He played a significant role as a chiropractor with additional responsibilities in providing chiropractic care for the U.S. team during the 2008 Summer Olympic Games held in Beijing, China. Furthermore, he served as the Medical Director for Team USA during the Winter Olympic Games in Vancouver in 2010.
